# Capstone_2
Capstone 2: Business Analysis with Python
## Project Overview

This project analyzes sales data for EmporiUm, a fictional student bookstore chain that also sells technology products, art supplies, and other merchandise.

The purpose of this project is to use Python data analysis tools to compare sales performance, customer activity, product trends, and marketing opportunities between two cross-region sales territories.

The territories analyzed in this project are:

- Colorado — Managed by Jim Heck (West Region)
- Florida — Managed by Lana Ilana (South Region)

The analysis uses:
- Python
- Pandas
- NumPy
- Matplotlib
- Jupyter Notebook

This project was completed as part of the Year Up United Data Analytics Training Academy Python Capstone.
